raw_text: OSINT accounts reporting PLA reinforcements near Galwan ahead of the June 15 anniversary. Satellite imagery shows new structures and vehicle staging. This happens every year but the scale seems larger than previous years. India has matched with its own deployments. The LAC situation remains tense despite 21 rounds of military talks. Any thoughts on whether this is seasonal or escalatory?
